about: The vector files carried into this repository, each with its SHA-256 and where it comes from; the code-rules gate checks every file of vectors/ but ts-0.1.0/ against it (DOC-04). The recordings of ts-0.1.0/ have their own PROVENANCE.json.

bip39-codec-v1.bin.source: 985 BIP39 entropy-to-index answers of @scure/bip39 2.4.0 under TS d4776f7, written by the earlier Rust attempt (archived); replaced in increment 3 by a recording of the TS repository's pnpm record:rust-parity

date-schedules-v1.bin.source: 50 Seedshift date schedules of TS d4776f7's dist/core/dates.js, written by the earlier Rust attempt (archived); replaced in increment 3 by a recording of the TS repository's pnpm record:rust-parity
